scenes.hook: H T M L Line Breaks. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Line breaks and thematic breaks have different meanings. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: B R creates a line break; H R marks a thematic break. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: A line break suits addresses and lines of a poem. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Use C S S spacing instead of repeated break elements for layout. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
